brief.description: Concise description of visible subject, action or state, and scene.

elements.description: Searchable noun phrases for visible static subjects, clothing, props, and scene objects.

use.description: Concise note describing the image's practical reference use.

key.description: Visible visual hook followed by its concrete reference value.

camera.description: Visible shot size, angle, framing, perspective, lens feel, and scale.

light_color.description: Visible lighting and color relationships described as one visual system.

suggest_title.description: Searchable replacement title only when the original title is generic or meaningless; empty string preserves it.

tags.description: Exact tags selected from the supplied taxonomy.

use_intents.description: Exact internal use-intent identifiers selected from the supplied list.
